'''Eintracht Frankfurt e.V.''' ({{IPA|de|ˈaɪntʁaxt ˈfʁaŋkfʊʁt|-|De-Eintracht Frankfurt.ogg}}) is a German professional [[sports club]] based in [[Frankfurt]], Hesse. It is best known for its [[football club]], which was founded on 8 March 1899. The club currently plays in the [[Bundesliga]], the top tier of the [[German football league system]]. Eintracht have won the [[List of German football champions|German championship]] once, the [[DFB-Pokal]] five times, the [[UEFA Europa League]] twice and finished as runner-up in the [[UEFA Champions League|European Cup]] (now known as the Champions League) once. The team was one of the founding members of the Bundesliga at its inception<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kicker.de/die-gruendungsmitglieder-der-bundesliga-572341/slideshow|title=Die Gründungsmitglieder der Bundesliga|website=kicker|access-date=8 April 2020}}</ref> and has spent a total of 57 seasons in the top division, thus making them the seventh longest participating club in the highest tier of the league.

The club has 155,000 members, and thus is the fourth largest club playing in German football.<ref>"[https://klub.eintracht.de/news/strukturelle-einigkeit-25-jahre-eintracht-frankfurt-fussball-ag-169547/ Strukturelle Einigkeit]", weltfussball, 1 July 2025,</ref>

Since 1925 their stadium has been the [[Waldstadion (Frankfurt)|Waldstadion]], which is currently named Deutsche Bank Park for sponsorship reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thestadiumbusiness.com/2020/04/01/commerzbank-arena-become-deutsche-bank-park/|title=Commerzbank-Arena To Become Deutsche Bank Park|date=1 April 2020|work=The Stadium Business|access-date=8 April 2020}}</ref>

Eintracht Frankfurt have either won or drawn more than three-quarters of their games as well as having finished the majority of their seasons placed in the top half of the table,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundesliga.com/de/bundesliga/clubs/eintracht-frankfurt/stats|title=Eintracht Frankfurt {{!}} Statistik|website=Bundesliga|access-date=16 July 2026}}</ref> but also having the highest number of losses in the league (717).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fussballdaten.de/bundesliga/ewige-tabelle/|title=Die ewige Tabelle der Bundesliga|website=Fussballdaten|access-date=8 April 2020}}</ref> With an average [[List of sports attendance figures|attendance]] of 59,071 in the 2025-26 Bundesliga season, the 4th highest attendance in the league.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.statista.com/statistics/282985/clubs-of-german-football-bundesliga-by-average-attendance/?srsltid=AfmBOoo7-lUFs-d9mOiPsEszwv6HWhG4GkIy8hlMvVb2iuCJlwgL2g2T|title=Average match attendance in the Bundesliga in 2025/26, by club
|date=16 July 2026|website=statista.com|access-date=16 July 2026}}</ref> The player with the highest number of appearances (602) in the Bundesliga, [[Charly Körbel]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/players/duit-bundesliga-matches.html|title=Germany – All-Time Most Matches Played in Bundesliga|date=20 June 2019|publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=8 April 2020}}</ref> spent his entire senior career as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]] for Eintracht Frankfurt. The club's primary rival is local club [[Kickers Offenbach]], although, due to spending most of their history in different divisions, the two have only played two league matches within the last 40 years.{{when|date=January 2024|reason='within the last 40 years'? the source is from... 2009.}}<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fr.de/eintracht-frankfurt/eine-historische-fussball-feindschaft-11499950.html|title=Eine historische Fußball-Feindschaft |website=Frankfurter Rundschau |date=31 July 2009 |language=de |access-date=31 July 2009}}</ref>

With almost 14,000 active athletes in over 50 sports in 2024, Eintracht Frankfurt is the largest [[multi-sports club]] in the world with a professional football team.<ref name="Eintracht Frankfurt f441">{{cite web | title=Eintracht liegt weltweit auf Rang eins | website=Eintracht Frankfurt | url=https://klub.eintracht.de/news/eintracht-liegt-weltweit-auf-rang-eins-156617/ | language=de | access-date=11 February 2024}}</ref>"}}
